Power

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:
Fuel Oil Booster Pump

Horizontal
 Centrifugal, 3UXHM 1013

Worthington
 Group

Equipment Inspection (
 I2-M6)
Introduction

This
document outlines the equipment inspection I2 which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The burner fuel oil boosters 
pumps (3 per unit) have capacity of 908 L/mint at a discharge pressure of 83 kg/Cm2 and 115C each
under normal operation two pumps are in service the discharge pressure of the 
pumps
is controlled by pressure control valve that recirculates
the oil back to the suction of the burner fuel oil heaters

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves, earplugs etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
the fan motor

Disconnect electric terminals 
of fan motor

The fan must be isolated 
mechanically by closing delivery damper

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out

Check bearing temperature 
so change the oil if needed or change the internal parts of bearing .
Check for excessive vibration
Check the stages and the other parts of the pump and change the defected parts.

Listen for unusual noise 
so check the bearing and the motor so change the defected parts.

Check mech. seal for leakage 
and change the mech. seal if needed.

Prior to stopping pump check bearing temperature and measure vibration (normal 
4.8 mm/s) change 
oil

Check the P/P for capacity and discharge
press. and repair or change the parts to restore the pressure discharge.
